title: Systematic Bug Fix Workflow
purpose: Standard procedure for receiving bug reports, prioritizing them, making targeted fixes, verifying with tests, and documenting outcomes. Ensures bugs are fixed safely with minimal regression risk.

reading_bug_reports.title: Reading and Understanding Bug Reports
reading_bug_reports.overview: Before fixing anything, fully understand the bug and its context.

steps.action: Read the complete bug report including reproduction steps, expected vs actual behavior, and environment details
steps.where_to_find: Bug reports may be in team session logs (teams/), knowledge base entries, bus messages (storage/coordination/bus/), or direct user reports

steps.action: Reproduce the bug to confirm it exists and understand its behavior
steps.command_example: Run the failing test or execute the reproduction steps from the bug report
steps.if_cannot_reproduce: Document the attempted reproduction steps and request more information. Do not guess at a fix.

steps.action: Identify the root cause by reading the relevant source code
steps.technique: Start from the error message or symptom, trace backwards through the call stack to find where behavior diverges from expectation

steps.action: Document your understanding: what the bug is, what causes it, and what files are affected
steps.output: Write a brief root cause analysis before making any code changes

prioritization.title: Prioritizing by Severity
prioritization.overview: Fix the most impactful bugs first. Use this severity classification.

critical.definition: System crashes, data loss, security vulnerabilities, or complete feature failure
critical.response: Fix immediately. Drop other work. This is a P0.
examples: SQLite database corruption on concurrent writes
Agent crash that loses all progress
Bus file corruption that blocks all communication

high.definition: Major feature degradation, significant performance issues, or blocking other teams
high.response: Fix within current session. High priority in the work queue.
examples: Help protocol fails to detect idle agents
Work stealing queue loses items under load

medium.definition: Minor feature issues, non-blocking workarounds exist, or cosmetic problems with functional impact
medium.response: Fix after critical and high bugs. Can be queued for next session if current session is full.
examples: Log messages have wrong severity level
Error messages are unclear but functionality works

low.definition: Cosmetic issues, minor inconveniences, or nice-to-have improvements
low.response: Fix when convenient. Log for future sessions.

prioritization_rules: Fix all critical bugs before starting on high
Fix all high bugs before starting on medium
If multiple bugs at the same severity, fix the one blocking the most teams first
If no blocking impact difference, fix the simplest one first to build momentum

making_fixes.title: Making Minimal Targeted Fixes
making_fixes.overview: Every fix should be the smallest possible change that resolves the bug without introducing new issues.

steps.action: Plan the fix before writing code
checklist: What exact change resolves the root cause?
What is the minimal set of files to modify?
Could this change break anything else?

steps.action: Make the fix in the minimal number of lines possible
rules: Change only what is necessary to fix the bug
Do not refactor surrounding code in the same fix
Preserve existing code style and conventions

steps.action: Add a comment explaining the fix if the change is non-obvious
steps.example: # Fix: Use BEGIN IMMEDIATE to prevent SQLite lock contention (SOP-021)

steps.action: If the fix requires changes to multiple files, make all changes before testing
steps.rationale: Partial fixes can create intermediate states that are harder to debug than the original bug

testing.title: Running Tests
testing.overview: Every fix must be verified with tests before being considered complete.

steps.action: Write a test that reproduces the bug (if one does not already exist)
steps.command: Add test to storage/coordination/tests/ or the appropriate test directory
steps.rule: The test must FAIL without the fix and PASS with the fix

steps.action: Run the specific test to verify the fix works
Run the full test suite to check for regressions
If stress tests exist for the affected module, run those too
steps.rationale: Concurrency bugs often only appear under load

steps.action: If any test fails, investigate whether it is related to your fix or a pre-existing issue
steps.if_related: Revise your fix. Do not merge a fix that breaks other tests.
steps.if_pre_existing: Document the pre-existing failure and proceed with your fix.

documenting_fixes.title: Documenting Fixes
documenting_fixes.overview: Every fix must be documented for future teams to understand what changed and why.

steps.action: Write a fix summary in your team output

format.bug_id: Reference to the original bug report
format.root_cause: One-sentence description of what caused the bug
format.fix_description: One-sentence description of what was changed

steps.action: If the fix reveals a pattern that could cause similar bugs elsewhere, create a knowledge base entry
Update the bug report status to resolved

per_bug: Read and understand the full bug report
Write regression test that fails without fix
Run specific test to verify fix
Run full test suite to check for regressions
session_complete: All high bugs fixed or documented with workarounds
Fix summaries written for every resolved bug
Knowledge base updated if fix reveals reusable patterns
